## Change

Describe the resulting catalogue facts or public contract. Cite first-party
sources for changed facts; explain compatibility for a contract change.

## Validation

List the relevant commands and results.

- [ ] Public contract changes have a matching entry in
      `catalogue/SCHEMA_CHANGELOG.md`, including
      compatible extensions and consumer-visible validation/generation semantics;
      or this PR does not change the public contract.
- [ ] Model/provider/price-only changes stay in generated release notes and do
      not add a schema-history entry.
